## Cheerilee (G4) — Miss Cheerilee

**Who she is.** Cheerilee is the kind, patient Earth-pony teacher at Ponyville Schoolhouse in *Friendship is Magic*. Recognize her by her magenta/cerise coat, two-tone pale-pink mane and tail, green eyes, and three smiling flower cutie marks. She says the flowers represent helping her pupils bloom through learning. Her most memorable adventure is the Cutie Mark Crusaders’ disastrous love-potion matchmaking with Big McIntosh in **“Hearts and Hooves Day.”** [Episode dialogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Call_of_the_Cutie)

**Alternate identity (IDW comics).** In *Friendship is Magic* comic **#29**, Cheerilee stands in for her injured twin **Cherry Blossom**, the wrestler who normally performs masked as **the Mystery Mare**. Cheerilee temporarily wears that persona; she is not the usual Mystery Mare, and this is a comics storyline rather than a television disguise. [Issue #29](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Friendship_is_Magic_Issue_29)

**Name, voice, and appearances.** **Cheerilee** is her established franchise name; **Miss Cheerilee** is her school honorific. Toys used the name before the series said it aloud: she first appears briefly in **“Boast Busters,”** speaks prominently in **“Call of the Cutie,”** is mentioned by name in **“Lesson Zero,”** and is addressed by name in **“The Cutie Pox.”** **“Cheerilee Pie”** appeared in early Gameloft previews, not as an established TV surname. She is **voiced by Nicole Oliver** (English) and speaks regularly. Other notable episodes include **“The Return of Harmony,” “Crusaders of the Lost Mark,” “The Cart Before the Ponies,”** and **“The Last Crusade.”** [Character and name chronology](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Cheerilee) · [Voice credit](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt2173455/characters/nm0646955/)

**Continuities.** The name/design draw from G3 Cheerilee toys/animations (including distinct unicorn and later Earth-pony versions); G3’s Scootaloo-sister relationship is **not** established for G4. The human **Equestria Girls** Cheerilee is a separate counterpart teaching/librarian at Canterlot High; *Pony Life* depicts a differently characterized party-shop owner. [G3 collector history](https://mylittlewiki.org/wiki/G3_Cheerilee) · [Equestria Girls counterpart](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Cheerilee_%28EG%29)
